gaps.explanation: The schedule total 52,556,767 equals the printed statement Total Receipts 52,556,767 (p3 Total Government Funds). The JSON statement receipt lines add to only 52,555,841 because the printed State row 9,723,460 (p3) was split into the fund-schedule State lines, which add to 9,722,534: the General Fund State lines on p4 (Inmate Housing 88,855 + Airline and Carline 43,850 + Insurance Tax Allocation 222,185 + Pro-Rate Motor Vehicle 73,611 + Homestead 789,255 + Property Tax Credit 1,494,227 + Other 271,662 = 2,983,645) are 926 less than the p3 General column State 2,984,571 (p3 General Other 3,591,141 is correspondingly 926 less than the p4 local lines). The statement receipt lines (State split, p3) are 926 short of the printed State 9,723,460 / Total Receipts 52,556,767; no detail fix.
